name: BMC - Lead Route and Provider Offer

parameters.jsCode: const p=$json.body??$json; const req=['form_type','market']; const missing=req.filter(k=>!String(p[k]??'').trim()); const consent=String(p.consent??'').toLowerCase()==='yes' || p.form_type==='vendor_response'; const serviceKey=p.form_type; let score=0; if(p.email||p.phone)score+=20;if(p.scope||p.problem)score+=20;if(p.market)score+=20;if(consent)score+=20;if(['ASAP','Urgent','Same day if possible'].includes(p.timing||p.urgency))score+=20; return [{json:{...p,service_key:serviceKey,consent,lead_score:score,status:missing.length||!consent?'exception':'received',exception_reason:missing.length?'missing:'+missing.join(','):(!consent?'missing_consent':'')}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {ok:$json.status!=='exception',status:$json.status,message:$json.status==='exception'?'Request needs review.':'Request received and queued for matching.'} }}
